First I need the browser tool schemas.The plan picker is on one line with Auto Pay on. I'll turn Auto Pay off and set it to four lines so the Unlimited price is the full monthly rate.Four Verizon Prepaid **Unlimited** lines are **$180 per month** without the Auto Pay discount.

That total is on the phone plans page at https://www.verizon.com/prepaid/plans/phone-plans/, with the line picker set to 4. With Auto Pay on, the same four Unlimited lines are **$140/mo**, and the page says that price already includes a **$60/mo** multiline discount. Auto Pay is a separate **$10 per line** ($40 for four lines) and only applies after the first month, so leaving it off puts the total at $180.

How that $180 breaks down, from the plan comparison on the same page:

- Unlimited is **$60/mo** per line before Auto Pay.
- Multiline takes **$20/mo off each line after the first**.
- Four lines: $60 + $40 + $40 + $40 = **$180/mo**.

The higher **Unlimited Plus** plan is separate. For four lines it is $180/mo with Auto Pay, or **$220/mo** without it. Additional taxes and fees may apply.
